name: Orc-sama to Majo ~Orcland Saga~
source:
Orcs are hated, scorned, and despised by humans.  
Nabatab, a young orc who despises his own kind and dreams of becoming human, makes a deal with a witch.  

“By the time you grow up, this land will be embroiled in war with humans.  
If you lead the orcs to victory, I’ll grant your wish.”  

But over a decade later, he’s grown into the leader of the orcs, living a life of indulgence, raping human women and forgetting all about the promise he made.  

Then one day, he becomes intrigued by a woman—Serina, the kingdom’s strongest knight, who even the mightiest men can’t touch.  
Leading his orc army, he confronts the Kingdom of Griaige, where Serina resides, and then…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ009777.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
兽人受到人类的憎恨、蔑视和蔑视。
纳巴塔布是一名年轻的兽人，他鄙视自己的同类，梦想成为人类，他与女巫做了一笔交易。

“等你长大后，这片土地将会与人类卷入战争。
如果你能带领兽人取得胜利，我就满足你的愿望。”  

但十多年后，他成长为兽人的领袖，过着放纵的生活，强奸人类妇女，忘记了自己的承诺。

然后有一天，他对一位女人产生了兴趣——塞琳娜，王国最强的骑士，即使是最强大的男人也无法触及。
他率领兽人大军，与塞琳娜居住的格里伊格王国对峙，然后……
